questions.question: After Israel gained control of the land under Joshua, what was still unfinished?

answers.text: Seven tribes haven't received their inheritance
The Tent of Meeting has no priest

questions.question: Before the land was divided among seven tribes, what did Joshua send men from each tribe out to do?

answers.text: Survey the land and map it out
Drive the Canaanites out of it
Build an altar in every region

questions.question: How did Joshua decide which of the seven tribes received which portion of the land?

answers.text: Giving the biggest tribe first pick
